isLockedOut

AxTableField.Name: IsCycleCountSupervisor
AxTableField.Label: Cycle count supervisor
AxTableField.HelpText: May review and approve inventory count variances. Distinct from Supervisor above - a worker can hold either, both, or neither.

AxTableField.Name: IsExternalCounter
AxTableField.Label: External counter
AxTableField.HelpText: A third-party counter: sees only counting journals assigned to their counter team, never prices, values or supervisor screens. Enforced by the counting services.

AxTableField.Name: CounterTeam
AxTableField.Label: Counter team
AxTableField.HelpText: The external counting team this worker belongs to. Counting journals are assigned to a team.

AxTableField.Name: MaxOverPercent
AxTableField.Label: Maximum over-delivery percent
AxTableField.HelpText: This worker's personal over-delivery allowance, as a percentage of ordered quantity. Zero means no personal override - the purchase order line's own D365FO-configured tolerance still applies unchanged. Only ever widens what a line already allows, never narrows it.

AxTableField.Name: MaxOverQty
AxTableField.Label: Maximum over-delivery quantity
AxTableField.HelpText: This worker's personal over-delivery allowance, as an absolute quantity above ordered. See Maximum over-delivery percent - the same "zero means unconfigured, only ever widens" rule.
